page.overview:
Who is Adolf Hitler?

Using others to do his dirty work, namely The Red Skull and Arnim Zola, along with a host of spies and foot soldiers, Hitler pulled the strings of his Nazi party in his conquest across primarily Europe.

Opposed by numerous heroes and teams, including Captain America and Bucky, The Invaders, and Nick Fury and his Howling Commandos, Hitler spread fear and destruction throughout the world for six years before being incinerated in a bunker outpost by The Human Torch.
